title: A bounded-width CNF for a conjunction of restricted gates
statement:
Fix natural numbers $n$, $s_2$, and $l$, a restriction $\rho_1$ on $n$ variables, and a family of DNF formulas $g_0, g_1, \dots, g_{s_2-1}$ on $n$ variables. For each index $i$, write $\tilde g_i$ for the restricted function $x \mapsto g_i(\rho_1.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$, obtained by evaluating $g_i$ with the coordinates fixed by $\rho_1$ set accordingly and the free coordinates supplied by $x$. Suppose that every $\tilde g_i$ has decision-tree depth at most $l$. Then there is a CNF formula $\Psi$ on $n$ variables of width at most $l$ in which each clause has no repeated literal and no two distinct literals sharing a variable, such that for every assignment $x$,
\[
\Psi(x) \;=\; \bigwedge_{i=0}^{s_2-1} \tilde g_i(x).
\]
hypotheses_covered: family of DNF formulas $g_i$ indexed by $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,s_2$
each restricted gate $\tilde g_i$ has decision-tree depth at most $l$
replaced:
If each restricted gate $\mathrm{restrictFn}\,(\mathrm{gates}\,i).\mathrm{eval}\,\rho_1$ has
decision-tree depth $\le l$, then there is a CNF $\Psi$ of width $\le l$, with nodup and
variable-injective clauses, whose evaluation equals the AND over all gates of their
restricted evaluations.
